evidence: The published workbook quality row 9 explicitly permits public networking. Its Internal Quality Checks row 9 retains old no-network wording; the published row and frozen SKILL.md Delivery profile supersede that wording. Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 declares build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2 and memory_mb=4096, exactly matching the frozen template environment table. Parsing confirms there is no environment env/credential literal, docker_image or allow_internet key. These are sane resources for the declared single Node/Express/SQLite process. The agent Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template: environment/Dockerfile:1-12 supplies Node 22, NODE_PATH, Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1; lines 14-23 copy only instructions/assets and initialize an empty app. Complete-file credential scans of every environment file found only the intentional Hireops!2026 demo password at hireops_rules.md:25,359, also publicly documented at instruction.md:13; the seed contains no credential fields and its user emails use hireops.example. The provider token at task.toml:34 is the separate-verifier ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template, not a literal secret. integration.md:3-14 and instruction.md:9 describe the installed packages and permit external browser assets. The raw evidence index SHA256 is 8592824b072a0ee5308bd4a7bf5a364d854cf475b658778b9e36b9b9f12a244d; all 129 listed artifacts matched on this review. build-agent.log SHA256 579142aab8976363e4fff69f47abc6e17414cc6560bfdcd3c68829e16917f5e0 records the dependency layers cached and a successful image export ff70849eebd9fcd2f91602ceb3518db6f6a1984d0e2f29f8a45019f4c24bc359. verification-local.json SHA256 412de3b7184b53532eb230d17c78738ff172a3b8b8cde639abd065732f8754f9 records docker build against this frozen environment path, exit 0, 3.609 seconds. I verified its task.toml and environment/Dockerfile hashes against current frozen bytes. artifact-binding.json SHA256 84b442344dc450b4ad5a9ed46fedffe3d358942c576288fa041dcbb250d807ab names the same agent image and three copied files, whose reported hashes I independently matched to the frozen source. This is bounded local build/source evidence; no cold-build duration, actual CPU/memory utilization, private checker execution, full configured judge, Oracle or portal result is asserted. Row 9 does not require those separate workload/scoring measurements.
counterexample: Considered a broken app that serves static pages or saves only in browser memory: it can run under this correct environment and therefore pass this environment-only row; determining its product failure belongs to the functional/gate rows and is not evidence against row 9. A concrete environmental fault such as network_mode="none", allow_internet=false, a literal provider credential, or docker_image shadowing active build steps would violate the inspected row and is absent. A conforming Node/Express/SQLite app using a CDN font could be falsely failed under the obsolete internal no-network wording; applying the published row and current skill permits that alternative. No row-9 counterexample remains.
